method: sum of safetensors data_offsets per weight-name group, from model.safetensors.index.json at the served checkpoint
gpu_vram_note: RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Server Edition: nvidia-smi memory.total = 97887 MiB
notes: No separate encoder/decoder weight sets exist. The vision encoder (ViT) is only ~1.0 GB.
The '552B asymmetric encoder-decoder / ~8B prefill / ~16B decode' is a COMPUTE-path difference over the SHARED layers.* MoE stack, not two weight tensors.
engram_memory (203 GB) is the n-gram/retrieval embedding tables (engram_layer_ids=[1,14], engram_vocab_size=16M); it is the only large CPU-offload candidate.
In SGLang PD disaggregation both the prefill pool and the decode pool load the FULL model; the split is by phase, KV is transferred prefill->decode.
